mapper.select:
SELECT u.user_id AS memberId, up.name AS memberName, up.gender AS gender, up.tier AS tier, COUNT(a.id) AS attendCount, MAX(a.attend_date) AS lastAttend FROM users u LEFT JOIN user_profiles up ON u.user_id = up.user_id JOIN user_gym ug ON ug.user_id = u.user_id AND ug.gym_id = #{gymId} AND ug.is_active = 1 LEFT JOIN attendance a ON a.user_id = u.user_id
WHERE u.role = 'MEMBER' AND u.is_active = 1 AND u.deleted_at IS NULL GROUP BY u.user_id, up.name, up.gender, up.tier ORDER BY attendCount DESC, up.name ASC

SELECT u.user_id AS memberId, up.name AS memberName, up.gender AS gender, up.tier AS tier, MAX(a.attend_date) AS lastAttend, DATEDIFF(CURDATE(), MAX(a.attend_date)) AS daysSince FROM users u LEFT JOIN user_profiles up ON u.user_id = up.user_id JOIN user_gym ug ON ug.user_id = u.user_id AND ug.gym_id = #{gymId} AND ug.is_active = 1 LEFT JOIN attendance a ON a.user_id = u.user_id WHERE u.role = 'MEMBER' AND u.is_active = 1 AND u.deleted_at IS NULL GROUP BY u.user_id, up.name, up.gender, up.tier HAVING daysSince >= #{days} OR lastAttend IS NULL ORDER BY daysSince DESC
